name: Natural Language Processing
description:
Content:
•	Text Normalization, Tokenization, N-Grams
•	Part-of-Speech-Tagging
•	Formal grammars for English and related approaches 
•	Syntactic, Statistical and Dependency Parsing
•	Word Embeddings (Word2Vec, GloVe etc.)
•	Word Sense Disambiguation
•	Sentiment Analysis
•	Information Extraction
•	Semantic Role Labelling
•	Co-Reference Resolution
•	Named Entity Recognition and Classification
•	Machine Translation
•       Modern Deep Learning Architectures for NLP
prerequisites:
IN2064 Machine Learning
IN2346 Introduction to Deep Learning

or equivalent knowledge. The lecture will not repeat basic ML / basic NN techniques and models in detail!
